functional_accounting.daily_count_interval: utc_day_start <= requestedAt < next_utc_day_start and requestedAt <= now
functional_accounting.remaining_total_formula: max(0, total_transaction_limit - count(transactions where requestedAt <= now))
functional_accounting.today_count_formula: count(transactions where utc_day_start <= requestedAt < next_utc_day_start and requestedAt <= now)
functional_accounting.next_allowed_formula: later of cooldown deadline and next UTC day start when the daily limit is active
functional_accounting.seven_day_formula: group actual transaction requestedAt timestamps into seven UTC day buckets
recompute_on: immediately before approving a service request
receiving a changed service transaction list
crossing a UTC day boundary while the view is active

ordered_steps: validate active offer and declared input roles
validate the complete form shape and every submitted value without writing data
load the active Discover publisher and resolve its public owner UID without writing data
load every root service transaction requested by the current user
calculate total usage, UTC daily usage, latest transaction and cooldown in memory
approve or deny the request without persisting calculated usage state
create and register the provider-owned form object when required
download the requester local form copy when required
create the service transaction and publish the reduced user summary
denied_attempts_do_not: persist counters, balances, timestamps or cooldown deadlines
